title: Chicago Cop Shoots Gunman Who Held Girlfriend Captive
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Chicago, Illinois — On March 20, 2025, Chicago Police Department (CPD) officers responded to a domestic-related call. As officers entered a residence, one of the officers encountered an armed individual, later identified him as 43-year-old Devon Smith, and victim inside a bedroom. As the victim fled the room, Smith pointed a firearm in the direction of the officer. The officer discharged their weapon, striking Smith. Officers handcuffed Smith and called paramedics to the scene. Smith was taken to the University of Chicago Hospital where he was pronounced deceased. The victim was transported to the hospital for treatment, as well as one officer for observation. A gun was recovered on scene.
